notes: Item 19 discloses Average and Median Annual Gross Sales for the 2024 Measurement Period (Jan 1 - Dec 31, 2024) broken down by years of operation. Four cohorts reported: less than 2 years (n=91), 3-6 years (n=149), 7+ years (n=147), and all franchisees (n=387). Min and max values extracted from narrative notes sections. No expense or profitability data disclosed. The 'less than 2 years' cohort technically covers 0-24 months, not strictly <12 months; open_lt_12mo was used as the closest available schema value. Similarly, 3-6 years maps to open_24_plus_mo and 7+ years maps to open_60_plus_mo as best available approximations.
